result.summary: Found 1 major layout issue in the bottom navigation.

issues.description: The bottom navigation is overlapped by a thick horizontal system/gesture indicator bar, and several navigation icons are clipped by the bottom edge. This makes the navigation appear broken and may hinder tapping the affected controls.
issues.suggestion: Respect the device bottom safe-area inset and add sufficient bottom padding to the navigation bar so all icons remain fully visible and clear of the gesture indicator.
